sn4.7:1.1: evamme sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn4.7:1.2: atha kho bhagavā bahudeva rattiṃ ajjhokāse caṅkamitvā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ pāde pakkhāletvā vihāraṃ pavisitvā
sn4.7:1.3: dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi pādena pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā.
sn4.7:1.4: atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
